the shear viscosity to entropy density of QCD is close to the minimum value of 1/4π in the temperature region of the phase transition or cross-over, and that this value is reached at a temperature of 200 MeV.

the QCD shear to entropy density ratio is monotonically increasing in temperature, reaches 0.4 with estimated 50% uncertainty at T = T c, and that a naive extrapolation shows that it reaches the 1/4π minimum bound at T ∼ T c.

the shear viscosity to entropy density of QCD at zero chemical potential is monotonically dropping in temperature, reaches ∼ 0.6 at T ≃ 120 MeV, and is likely to stay close to 1 / 3 π to 1 / ( 3 π ) around the deconfinment temperature.
